provenanceNote: PA 600 (8/24). Person 1 maps to the applicant; Persons 2-7 map to household.members[0..5]. The person section is marked for non-SNAP programs ('you do not need to answer these questions if you are applying only for SNAP'); fields still map for households that answer them. Income rows exist for Persons 1-4 only. Skipped as unsupported: race/ethnicity detail, sponsor and tax fields, insurance detail, criminal history, and signature/office-use blocks.
